Question:
How does a right angle compare with an acute angle?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p101_q1_question_en.svg)

Choices.A: A right angle is larger than an acute angle
Choices.B: A right angle is smaller than an acute angle
Choices.C: A right angle and an acute angle are equal in size

Solution: An acute angle is smaller than a right angle.
